FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Legion Ranks
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Spar with any colonist in the Roman style. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Study the tradecraft of the Frumentarii with another initiate. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked legionary's weapon and armor as Caesar's law demands. Well-kept gear earns praise, neglected gear earns the lash's warning.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Sentence a lower-ranked legionary to a stretch of hard labor for their failure, souring their mood. Once per day per legionary.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Call {0} to arms with a burst of speed and battle-fury. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to form ranks behind you, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold formation until released.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Release {0} from formation, letting them return to their duties.
